risk_note: RV2 identity and orders admin reads (FU-ADMIN-LOOKUP-FIELD-AUDIT; contract CT-24zzd; rulings D10-1042, D10-1048 ①②, D10-1074, D10-1084). Accounts without the matching business point get internal text and platform ratios blanked: adminGetUser / adminLookupUser risk.reason without any risk.* point; adminGetOrder last_hold_note, commission_rate_bp and commission_split.reserve_bp without order.view; adminGetClaim reason without order.claim. Whether to blank is decided once per endpoint from actor.permissions (handed over through withPermissions); it never decides who is let in, and a non-super actor without permissions is blanked. Blanking happens in the controller after the read; enum reasons, evidence, masked values and amounts stay. One frozen test changes its expectation by ledger declaration: [AC-F1-07b#23] now expects risk.reason null for a user.lookup-only account (D10-1084, tighten_only). Integration lookup-blank-fields plus the frozen admin-users, admin-orders-read, claims and guard directories 172/172. Write endpoints' read-backs are B1-10p.

reviews.note: codex-run.sh review --review-type money (D10-1075, medium) over the whole implementation from the last rule-test commit: pass with no findings. Static, nothing executed by Codex. One out-of-scope S1 (write endpoints' read-back still shows the blanked fields) was ruled a separate task by the orchestrator (B1-10p, FU-ADMIN-WRITE-READBACK-BLANK). couli-runs/B1-10o/review-money-r1.json.

Round 3 is the read-only re-check D10-1084 asks for: the frozen test's diff is exactly one line. Red on the round-2 spec commit: red/1 ok, 13 red; red/2 on the round-3 spec commit ok, the modify_existing block left out of the expected list by design.
